news.title: Purdue researchers get NIH grant to prepare next generation of biomedical scientists
news.summary_en: Purdue Engineers have been awarded a training grant by the National Institute of General Medical Sciences to prepare graduate students to fill the growing national need for scientists who can lead the design, characterization and application of engineered biological systems.

news.title: Civil engineering lab is latest Purdue facility to achieve internationally recognized quality management certification
news.summary_en: Credential will help facilitate partnerships with construction and nuclear industries

news.title: Motorsports engineering student in Indianapolis put to the test in short-track racing
news.summary_en: Growing up in Illinois, aspiring race car driver Noah Eisenhower has competed at some of the toughest short tracks in the country. But he has a secret weapon: a Purdue education in Motorsports Engineering.

news.title: IE’s Johnson visits Capitol Hill to advocate for federal science and engineering funding
news.summary_en: Professor David Johnson traveled to Washington, D.C., on Sept. 24 to meet with congressional delegations and staff, and participate in the Coalition for National Science Funding’s Science Showcase

news.title: Purdue-led biotech accelerator selected for SBA funding
news.summary_en: Over a two-year period, the B-PRIME Accelerator will help small manufacturers meet the technical, regulatory and production requirements of the pharmaceutical industry

news.title: "Finding Amelia" A podcast miniseries about the search for Amelia Earhart's missing plane
news.summary_en: On what would've been Amelia Earhart's 129th birthday, the Purdue Research Foundation and the Archaeological Legacy Institute announced a renewed joint effort to identify Amelia Earhart's missing university-sponsored plane.
